b1-unit-43.43.1 Carol arrives at Ana's:
Ana: Welcome! Come in, come in. Let me take your suitcase.
Carol: Thank you! Oh, it's so good to see you.
Ana: It's so good to see you too. How was your flight?
Carol: Long! The man next to me snored all night, so I didn't sleep at all.
Ana: Oh no! Well, make yourself at home. You can rest this afternoon.
Carol: You have a lovely apartment. Is this the new kitchen?
Ana: Yes! It was finished last month. We painted it ourselves... well, Danny painted most of it.
Carol: It's beautiful. Oh, before I forget, I brought you some chocolates. And this T-shirt is for Leo.
Ana: That's so kind of you! He'll love it. Can I get you something to drink? A coffee?
Carol: Yes, please. A coffee would be great.
Ana: How do you take it?
Carol: With a little milk, no sugar.
Ana: Here you are. And would you like some lunch? I made rice, beans and chicken.
Carol: No thanks, I'm fine. I ate on the plane. But could I try one of those little cheese breads? They look delicious.
Ana: Of course. Help yourself! Take as many as you want.
Carol: Thanks. Could I have your Wi-Fi password? I need to tell my boss I arrived safely.
Ana: Sure. It's on the fridge.
Carol: And is it all right if I take a shower?
Ana: Go ahead. There are clean towels in your room.
Carol: And one more thing... could I borrow your car tomorrow? I'd like to drive to the beach.
Ana: I'm afraid Marcos needs it for work this week. And honestly, driving in São Paulo is not for beginners! I'll take you on Saturday.
Carol: That's very kind of you. Oh, and guess what? I've been teaching myself Portuguese with an app for six months!
Ana: Really? Leo will be so happy. He's learning English at school, so you can teach each other!
Carol: Perfect. Now I'm going to enjoy myself for two whole weeks.
Ana: You deserve it. Go and relax. Your room is the second door on the left.
